items.title: Eli Lilly (LLY) Steps Up Legal Fight Over Illegal Retatrutide Sales
items.summary: Eli Lilly (NYSE: LLY) has intensified legal action against U.S. entities accused of selling unauthorized versions of its experimental obesity drug retatrutide. The company is pursuing multiple lawsuits as part of a broader effort to curb black market distribution of the unapproved treatment. Eli Lilly is also engaging regulators and online platforms to address patient safety risks and protect its obesity drug portfolio. This kind of legal push around high demand obesity treatments...
